head: 9756970ce19a64d6ac0e913631193b606dc78e7c
blocker01Repair: Resolve the canonical latest published revision before both writer no-op decisions and compare position, completion, and contentRevisionId.
originalBlocker02: LecturePlayer lacks a proven identity/reset boundary across lecture reuse
blocker02Repair: Key LecturePlayer by learner, lecture, and latest published revision; reset on key change and guard stale unmounted responses.
semanticProgressIdentity: Authenticated learner + canonical audio/lecture item; LecturePlayer reuse identity additionally includes latest published contentRevisionId.
serverNoopPredicate: Existing authenticated/access-scoped learner/item row plus normalized position, sticky completion, and canonical contentRevisionId.

contentRevisionIdSemantics.sameRevision: NO_OP when all other semantic state is equal
contentRevisionIdSemantics.nullToRevision: WRITE when canonical latest revision appears
contentRevisionIdSemantics.revisionToNull: WRITE when canonical latest revision becomes absent and nullable legacy semantics apply
contentRevisionIdSemantics.nullToNull: NO_OP when all other semantic state is equal
contentRevisionIdSemantics.missingCallerField: Not an authority input; server derives canonical revision
contentRevisionIdSemantics.malformedCallerField: Not an authority input; existing validation/schema behavior applies

completionSemantics: current.completed || input.complete remains sticky; completed rows retain their established revision and cannot regress.
lecturePlayerResetBoundary: React key `${user?.id ?? anonymous}:${lecture.id}:${revision?.id ?? none}` plus mounted cleanup/stale-response guard.
lectureReuseResult: PASS: Lecture A/revision 1 to Lecture B/revision 1 changes identity and resets transient checkpoint state.
revisionReuseResult: PASS: Lecture A/revision 1 to Lecture A/revision 2 changes identity and revision sync forces the first meaningful checkpoint when uncompleted.
ordinaryRerenderResult: PASS: same semantic key remains stable and does not reset or add a recurring writer.
pendingStaleRequestResult: PASS: cleanup cancels timer/removes listener; unmounted old instance cannot drain queued state or update replacement UI.
crossUserSafety: PASS: existing authenticated user and user/item-scoped repository predicates preserved.
crossLectureSafety: PASS: existing access checks, lecture key, request lectureId, and repository lookup remain scoped.
clientHttpSuppression: 30-second bounded cadence, dirty/acknowledged-state gate, revision mismatch gate, one in-flight request, latest-only pending state, bounded retry.
serverDbNoopSuppression: Equal canonical position/completion/revision skips the insert/upsert; HTTP invocation still occurs.
historicalCausationClaim: None; this repair reduces a plausible recurrence path and does not explain the historical Aug 21-26 usage spike.
remainingWork: Independent final rereview, then clean-main publication preparation if approved.
